answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target and confined to primary region. Rollback is ruled out due to compliance on the security patch. Regional failover has proven fast latency recovery (memory_b2: minutes to restore). Verifying b2 confirms the failover path works under load. Write volume is heavy but failover preserves writes by shifting traffic cleanly rather than dropping it. This is the only intervention that handles latency containment without reverting the security patch or relying on capacity that may take time to provision.
